title: Detailed camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Camera body -->
  <rect x="12" y="32" width="76" height="50" rx="9" fill="#3a4a6b"/>
  <!-- Body top highlight -->
  <rect x="12" y="32" width="76" height="15" rx="9" fill="#4d5f85"/>
  <!-- Grip texture -->
  <rect x="16" y="38" width="14" height="38" rx="5" fill="#2d3a55"/>
  <rect x="18" y="42" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <rect x="18" y="48" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <rect x="18" y="54" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <rect x="18" y="60" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <!-- Viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x="36" y="24" width="30" height="14" rx="5" fill="#3a4a6b"/>
  <rect x="36" y="24" width="30" height="7" rx="5" fill="#4d5f85"/>
  <rect x="44" y="27" width="14" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8fd4e8"/>
  <!-- Flash -->
  <rect x="70" y="26" width="14" height="9" rx="2" fill="#4d5f85"/>
  <rect x="73" y="29" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <!-- Shutter button -->
  <rect x="24" y="28" width="12" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#e86a6a"/>
  <!-- Mode dial -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="36" r="5" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="36" r="2.5" fill="#e8c46a"/>
  <!-- Lens barrel outer -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="20" fill="#2d3a55"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#5a6d94" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Lens mid ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="15" fill="#4d5f85"/>
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="10" fill="#1a2238"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#8fd4e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Lens reflection -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="54" r="4" fill="#8fd4e8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="61" r="2" fill="#b8f0ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Lens center glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="4" fill="#3a5a8c"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="2" fill="#8fd4e8"/>
  <!-- Bottom detail lights -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#6ae8a0"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#e8c46a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#e86a6a"/>
  <!-- Strap lug left -->
  <rect x="10" y="48" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <circle cx="13" cy="53" r="2" fill="#2d3a55"/>
  <!-- Strap lug right -->
  <rect x="84" y="48" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="53" r="2" fill="#2d3a55"/>
  <!-- Hot shoe -->
  <rect x="44" y="20" width="14" height="4" rx="1" fill="#5a6d94"/>
  <rect x="46" y="18" width="10" height="3" rx="1" fill="#8a9bbf"/>
</svg>
